children: Utah Medical Products announced Femcare acquired Orion Medical Supplies, expected to add about $6 million to consolidated annual sales.
Femcare, Utah Medical Products' wholly-owned unit, purchased all common shares of UK-based Orion Medical Supplies Ltd.
Purchase price was £3.6 million paid from Utah Medical Products' cash reserves.
Orion's harm-reduction kits are well-accepted by the NHS and other European organizations, providing a stable revenue stream.
Acquisition is expected to add about $6 million to consolidated annual sales and can expand geographically.
Orion operations will move into Femcare’s Romsey facilities to leverage infrastructure and dilute UK overhead.
